subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should this external memory-core recovery PR remain blocked on live Gateway/provider outage proof, or should maintainers explicitly override the proof gate for the deterministic manager-level regression?
rationale: Repository policy requires real behavior proof for external non-doc PRs, but the contributor says no live Gateway/Ollama outage harness is currently available and asks maintainers to choose whether deterministic proof is enough.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked until redacted terminal output, logs, a recording, or a linked artifact shows Gateway memory_search falling back during an outage, recovering the primary provider, and returning results afterward.

options.title: Override proof after maintainer review
options.body: Apply an explicit proof override if maintainers decide the deterministic MemoryIndexManager regression is sufficient for this provider-state fix.

options.title: Pause for replacement proof path
options.body: Leave this PR open but wait for a maintainer-owned or ClawSweeper-owned live harness/proof path before landing any implementation for the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but blocked until redacted terminal output, logs, a recording, or a linked artifact shows Gateway memory_search falling back during an outage, recovering the primary provider, and returning results afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history on the memory manager/provider-state files and is the clearest routing candidate for a proof-sufficiency call in this area.
